title: Arabic (RTL) homepage
description: Create ar/index.html: a full Arabic translation of index.html with lang=ar dir=rtl, Cairo font from Google Fonts, RTL-aware CSS overrides (add a [dir=rtl] section in styles.css: mirrored arrows, eyebrow line, text alignment). Asset paths must be ../assets/. Add a language switcher (EN / ع) in the header of every page.

title: Arabic (RTL) products page
description: Create ar/products.html translating products.html. Link it from the Arabic header and ensure the filter chips work. Depends on the Arabic homepage task being done first; if ar/index.html does not exist yet, release this task.

title: Railway solutions page
description: Create railways.html: a sector page for railway, metro and LRT projects covering signalling cables, traction power cabling, overhead line equipment, rolling-stock wiring and tunnel fire-performance (LSZH) requirements. Include a line-art SVG illustration, a 'typical scope' list, and a CTA to the contact form. Add it to the nav and footer on every page, and link the Railways sector card on the homepage to it.

title: Power & utilities solutions page
description: Create power-utilities.html, a sector page for distribution networks and substations (MV/HV cables, joints and terminations, switchgear components, earthing). Same structure and linking rules as the railway page.

title: About page
description: Create about.html describing the company's role as importer and supplier, its approach (specification-first sourcing, import & customs, documentation, engineering support) and values. Do NOT invent founding year, team names, clients or certifications. Add to nav and footer.

title: Contact form backend via Cloudflare Pages Function
description: Add sites/electmotion/functions/api/contact.js (a Cloudflare Pages Function; functions/ must sit inside the Pages root directory) that validates the quote form and returns JSON, with a honeypot field against spam. Update main.js to POST to /api/contact and fall back to the current mailto behaviour on failure. Leave actual email delivery as a clearly marked TODO in the function (owner must choose a provider) and add a backlog task describing what is needed.

title: Quality & documentation page
description: Create quality.html explaining the documentation provided with orders (factory test reports, certificates of origin, conformity documents, datasheets), inspection before shipment, and the standards we source against. Neutral wording: no certifications claimed.

title: Downloadable-style datasheet cards
description: On products.html, add for each category a compact 'What to send us for a quote' list (e.g. voltage, conductor, cross-section, cores, armour, sheath, length, standard). Keep the layout clean on mobile.

title: SEO: sitemap and canonical tags
description: Add sites/electmotion/sitemap.xml for https://electmotion.com (clean URLs without .html are also served by Cloudflare Pages; use the .html URLs consistently), reference it from robots.txt, and add canonical tags (and og:url) to every page. When Arabic pages exist, add hreflang en/ar alternates.

title: Open Graph share image
description: Create assets/img/og-image.svg-based design and, since social networks need raster images, document in the task summary that a 1200x630 PNG export is needed; reference it via og:image only if a PNG exists.

title: Accessibility pass
description: Audit all pages for colour contrast (WCAG AA), focus states, keyboard navigation of the mobile menu, form labels and error messages, and aria usage. Fix what you find.

title: FAQ section
description: Add an FAQ section (details/summary accordion) to the homepage above the contact section: lead times depend on product and origin, minimum order, documentation provided, delivery across Egypt, how to send a BOQ. Keep answers non-committal where facts are unknown (no numbers).

title: Glossary of cable terms
description: Create glossary.html explaining terms buyers meet in specifications: XLPE, LSZH, SWA/AWA, screen, U0/U (Um), OPGW, OCS, axle counter, balise. Link from products page.

title: Performance polish
description: Reduce render-blocking: font-display swap is in place; consider preloading key fonts, deferring non-critical CSS, and trimming unused CSS. Keep the site visually identical.
